entries.20395186c76fa30a: Companies conducting marketing activities on the internet (advertisers)
entries.51862d20275388f2: A company that operates the affiliate advertising service "A8.net" and supports companies' marketing through performance-based internet advertising.
entries.594f5c69f61c6ada: This business operates the comedy radio app “GERA”, the online community service “YOOR”, the digital marketing process optimization support service “N-INE” and others. Consolidated subsidiary WAND Co., Ltd. handles influencer marketing under “LUMOS BUZZ”, and FAN Communications Global Co., Ltd. supports overseas advertisers entering the Japanese market and handles game app business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,435 million.
entries.8ef6952e064d80bd: Companies and individuals operating sites that serve as advertising media (partner sites)
entries.d8178c9103c6a8f7: It is headquartered in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group with the Company and 3 consolidated subsidiaries. It operates 2 businesses, the CPA Solutions Business and the Strategy Business, and the consolidated number of employees for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was 356. It is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.e8df67bc5bf58725: Users of apps and online services
entries.f9fc464c99fd6309: This business operates the affiliate advertising service “A8.net” and the CPI advertising service for smartphone apps “A8app”. Under this scheme, when purchases, member registrations or other results occur on an advertiser's site, rewards are paid according to those results to partner sites that serve as advertising media; the Company is responsible for calculating the results of each advertisement, collecting advertising fees from advertisers, and paying rewards to partner sites. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,660 million.
